title: Tabs
description: Switch between panels of content inside a page or card: underline (default) or segmented, with icons and counts.
when: Sections of one object: Tổng quan / Hoạt động / Cài đặt.
A segmented period switch that changes a panel (variant="segmented").

instead.need: 5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages)
2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page
2–5 filter values shown in full, with counts

a11y: tablist / tab / tabpanel; ←/→, Home, End move; the panel is linked to its tab.
